p.src: 1  The elder to Gaius the beloved, whom I love in truth.

ja: するガイオへ。私はあなたを真理のうちに愛しています。
en: The elder to Gaius the beloved, whom I love in truth.
u.src: 1  The elder to Gaius the beloved, whom I love in truth.

p.src: 2  Beloved, I pray that you may prosper in all things and be healthy, even as your soul prospers.

ja: が栄えているように、すべてのことが順調に進み、
康であるように祈っています。
en: Beloved, I pray that you may prosper in all things and be healthy, even as your soul prospers.
u.src: 2  Beloved, I pray that you may prosper in all things and be healthy, even as your soul prospers.

p.src: 3  For I rejoiced greatly when brothers came and testified about your truth, even as you walk in truth.

ja: て、あなたのうちにある
について証しし、あなたが
んでいると伝えてくれたので、私は
en: For I rejoiced greatly when brothers came and testified about your truth, even as you walk in truth.
u.src: 3  For I rejoiced greatly when brothers came and testified about your truth, even as you walk in truth.

p.src: 4  I have no greater joy than this: to hear about my children walking in truth.

en: I have no greater joy than this: to hear about my children walking in truth.
u.src: 4  I have no greater joy than this: to hear about my children walking in truth.

p.src: 5  Beloved, you do a faithful work in whatever you accomplish for those who are brothers and strangers.

ja: たちのために行うすべてのことを、あなたは忠実に果たしています。
en: Beloved, you do a faithful work in whatever you accomplish for those who are brothers and strangers.
u.src: 5  Beloved, you do a faithful work in whatever you accomplish for those who are brothers and strangers.

p.src: 6  They have testified about your love before the assembly. You will do well to send them forward on their journey in a way worthy of God,

ja: ししました。彼らが旅を続けられるよう、
で送り出してくだされば幸いです。
en: They have testified about your love before the assembly. You will do well to send them forward on their journey in a way worthy of God,
u.src: 6  They have testified about your love before the assembly. You will do well to send them forward on their journey in a way worthy of God,

p.src: 7  because for the sake of the Name they went out, taking nothing from the Gentiles.

en: because for the sake of the Name they went out, taking nothing from the Gentiles.
u.src: 7  because for the sake of the Name they went out, taking nothing from the Gentiles.

p.src: 8  We therefore ought to receive such, that we may be fellow workers for the truth.

ja: ですから、私たちはそのような
en: We therefore ought to receive such, that we may be fellow workers for the truth.
u.src: 8  We therefore ought to receive such, that we may be fellow workers for the truth.

p.src: 9  I wrote to the assembly, but Diotrephes, who loves to be first among them, doesn’t accept what we say.

ja: になりたがるディオトレフェスは、
en: I wrote to the assembly, but Diotrephes, who loves to be first among them, doesn’t accept what we say.
u.src: 9  I wrote to the assembly, but Diotrephes, who loves to be first among them, doesn’t accept what we say.

p.src: 10  Therefore, if I come, I will call attention to his deeds which he does, unjustly accusing us with wicked words. Not content with this, he doesn’t receive the brothers himself, and those who would, he forbids and throws out of the assembly.

ja: しています。それでも飽き
en: Therefore, if I come, I will call attention to his deeds which he does, unjustly accusing us with wicked words. Not content with this, he doesn’t receive the brothers himself, and those who would, he forbids and throws out of the assembly.
u.src: 10  Therefore, if I come, I will call attention to his deeds which he does, unjustly accusing us with wicked words. Not content with this, he doesn’t receive the brothers himself, and those who would, he forbids and throws out of the assembly.

p.src: 11  Beloved, don’t imitate that which is evil, but that which is good. He who does good is of God. He who does evil hasn’t seen God.

en: Beloved, don’t imitate that which is evil, but that which is good. He who does good is of God. He who does evil hasn’t seen God.
u.src: 11  Beloved, don’t imitate that which is evil, but that which is good. He who does good is of God. He who does evil hasn’t seen God.

p.src: 12  Demetrius has the testimony of all, and of the truth itself; yes, we also testify, and you know that our testimony is true.

ja: デメテリオは、すべての
そのものも彼について
しします。そして、あなたは
en: Demetrius has the testimony of all, and of the truth itself; yes, we also testify, and you know that our testimony is true.
u.src: 12  Demetrius has the testimony of all, and of the truth itself; yes, we also testify, and you know that our testimony is true.

p.src: 13  I had many things to write to you, but I am unwilling to write to you with ink and pen;

ja: きたいことはたくさんありますが、インクとペンで
en: I had many things to write to you, but I am unwilling to write to you with ink and pen;
u.src: 13  I had many things to write to you, but I am unwilling to write to you with ink and pen;

p.src: 14  but I hope to see you soon. Then we will speak face to face. Peace be to you. The friends greet you. Greet the friends by name.

ja: えることを願っています。その時には、
わせて話しましょう。 あなたに
たちがあなたによろしくと
en: but I hope to see you soon. Then we will speak face to face. Peace be to you. The friends greet you. Greet the friends by name.
u.src: 14  but I hope to see you soon. Then we will speak face to face. Peace be to you. The friends greet you. Greet the friends by name.

zh: 願你平安。眾位朋友都問你安。請你替我按着姓名問眾位朋友安。
